stamford.hp: Made-to-measure kitchens, wardrobes and bedrooms for Stamford’s period and family homes, handcrafted in our Peterborough workshop, a short drive away.
stamford.big: Stamford’s Georgian townhouses, stone cottages and conservation-area homes are rarely a standard shape, which is exactly why we build to measure.
kp: Stamford is around 15 miles from our Brassey Close workshop, usually 25 to 30 minutes via the A47 and A1. That makes it one of the easiest towns for us to reach: design visits, final measures and fitting days run on a normal Peterborough-area schedule, and if something needs a return visit we can be back the same week.

Stamford was England’s first designated conservation area, and much of the town is honey-coloured limestone: Georgian townhouses, older cottages around St Martin’s and the town centre, and newer family homes on the edges of town.
stamford.dp: Our showroom and workshop are in Peterborough, around 15 miles from Stamford. As well as the town itself, we design and fit in Easton on the Hill, Ketton, Uffington and Great Casterton.
fq: How far is Stamford from your workshop?
About 15 miles, or 25 to 30 minutes on the A47 and A1. Design visits, final measures and fitting days are easy to arrange, and if anything needs a return visit we can usually be back the same week.
Do I need permission for fitted furniture in a listed or conservation-area home?

Usually not for the furniture itself. Stamford was England’s first conservation area, though, and work that touches original fabric, such as removing a wall, altering a chimney breast or fixing into panelling, may need consent.

oundle.hp: Bespoke kitchens, wardrobes and bedrooms for Oundle’s handsome stone homes, designed, made and installed by our Peterborough team.
oundle.big: Oundle’s limestone houses and Georgian frontages deserve joinery made with the same care, so we build around the room, not around standard units.
kp: Oundle is about 13 miles from our Peterborough workshop, normally 25 minutes along the A605. We regularly cover Oundle and the villages around it, so surveys and fitting days are straightforward to schedule, and our fitters can get back quickly for any adjustments after handover.
Much of Oundle is built in local limestone, with Georgian and older stone houses through the conservation area and around the school, and more recent homes on the town’s edges.
oundle.dp: Our showroom and workshop are in Peterborough, around 13 miles from Oundle. As well as the town itself, we design and fit in Barnwell, Ashton, Cotterstock and Fotheringhay.
fq: How far is Oundle from your workshop?

About 13 miles, usually 25 minutes along the A605. We work in Oundle and the villages around it regularly, so visits are easy to arrange and our fitters can get back quickly for any adjustments after handover.
Can you get fitted furniture into an old stone cottage?
Yes. Low beams and tight staircases limit how big each piece can be, so we plan for that from the start and build larger runs in sections that we assemble in the room.

market-deeping.hp: Bespoke fitted kitchens, wardrobes and bedrooms for the Deepings, one of our closest communities, handcrafted in Peterborough.
market-deeping.big: The Deepings are about 9 miles from our workshop, and most of the homes we fit here need more storage from compact rooms.
kp: Market Deeping is one of our closest areas, around 9 miles from our workshop and typically a 20-minute drive up the A15. We cover the Deepings regularly, which keeps survey appointments flexible and means any follow-up visit after fitting is easy to arrange.
The Deepings combine older stone properties around the Market Place and along the River Welland with a large share of homes built from the 1970s onwards, plus newer developments.
market-deeping.dp: Our showroom and workshop are in Peterborough, around 9 miles from Market Deeping. As well as Market Deeping itself, we design and fit in Deeping St James, Deeping Gate, West Deeping and Frognall.
fq: How quickly can you visit homes in the Deepings?

Usually very quickly. Market Deeping is about 9 miles from our workshop, around 20 minutes up the A15, so design visits across Market Deeping, Deeping St James and Deeping Gate are easy to fit around you.
My house is fairly new. Will fitted furniture affect the builder’s warranty?

Tell us what’s still under warranty and we’ll talk through what you’re changing at the survey, so the work doesn’t affect any cover you rely on. We also plan fixings around stud walls before we start.

bourne.hp: Made-to-measure kitchens, wardrobes and bedrooms for Bourne homes, designed and built in our Peterborough workshop.
bourne.big: From period houses near the town centre to the open-plan homes at Elsea Park, we build every Bourne kitchen and wardrobe to the room it’s going in.
kp: Bourne is about 16 miles from our Peterborough workshop, usually around 30 minutes via the A15. That’s well within our regular area, so design visits, final measures and fitting are all handled by the same in-house team that covers Peterborough.
Bourne mixes period stone and brick houses in and around the town centre with a large amount of newer housing, including the Elsea Park development.
bourne.dp: Our showroom and workshop are in Peterborough, around 16 miles from Bourne. As well as Bourne itself, we design and fit in Morton, Thurlby, Rippingale and Dyke.
fq: Do you fit kitchens in Bourne and the nearby villages?
Yes. Bourne is about 16 miles from our workshop, usually around 30 minutes via the A15, and we also cover Morton, Thurlby, Rippingale and Dyke.
Can the kitchen, media wall and utility match in an open-plan home?
Yes, and in open-plan rooms that’s often the best approach. We design them as one scheme, with the same finish running through, so the whole space looks planned.

spalding.hp: Bespoke fitted kitchens, wardrobes, bedrooms and storage for Spalding family homes, handcrafted in Peterborough.
spalding.big: Spalding’s mix of riverside Georgian houses, bungalows and new estates means no two rooms are alike, so everything we make is built to measure.
kp: Spalding is around 18 miles from our Brassey Close workshop, typically 30 to 35 minutes via the A16 through Crowland. We cover Spalding and the surrounding South Holland villages as part of our regular area, with the same in-house team handling design, manufacture and installation.

Spalding has a strong mix of housing: Georgian and Victorian properties along the River Welland and around the town centre, and large numbers of more modern homes on the newer estates around the town.
spalding.dp: Our showroom and workshop are in Peterborough, around 18 miles from Spalding. As well as Spalding itself, we design and fit in Pinchbeck, Weston, Cowbit and Deeping St Nicholas.
fq: Do you cover Spalding and the South Holland villages?
Yes. Spalding is about 18 miles from our workshop, usually 30 to 35 minutes via the A16 through Crowland, and we fit across Pinchbeck, Weston, Cowbit and Deeping St Nicholas too.
My floors and walls aren’t level. Is that a problem?
No. It’s common in older fenland properties. We allow for it when we measure and use adjustable legs, scribed fillers and made-to-measure panels so everything sits straight.

huntingdon.hp: Bespoke kitchens, wardrobes and bedrooms for Huntingdon homes, designed, made and installed by our Peterborough team.
huntingdon.big: In Huntingdon we fit everything from period homes near the centre to new builds at Alconbury Weald, and each room gets furniture made for it.
kp: Huntingdon is about 20 miles from our Peterborough workshop, usually around 30 minutes down the A1(M) and A14. It’s well within our regular area, and we also cover Godmanchester, Brampton and the surrounding villages with the same team.
The town has period properties around the historic centre, plenty of post-war and later family homes, and significant new building nearby, such as Alconbury Weald.
huntingdon.dp: Our showroom and workshop are in Peterborough, around 20 miles from Huntingdon. As well as Huntingdon itself, we design and fit in Godmanchester, Brampton, Hartford and the Hemingfords.
fq: Do you cover Huntingdon, Godmanchester and Brampton?
Yes. Huntingdon is about 20 miles from our workshop, usually around 30 minutes via the A1(M) and A14, and we fit across Godmanchester, Brampton, Hartford and the Hemingfords with the same team.
Can you replace the developer kitchen in a new build?

Yes, it’s one of our most common jobs, including at Alconbury Weald. Planning the new kitchen around the existing plumbing and sockets usually keeps costs down, and we often add a utility or media wall at the same time.
